paper_metadata.title: Designing Ternary Laves Phase-Based Eutectic Alloys CrFeNbx with Excellent Strength, Toughness, and Thermal Stability

evidence.quote: Three ternary Laves phase-based eutectic alloys CrFeNbx (x = 2.0, 2.35, 2.7) were designed successfully by combining the binary phase diagrams and thermodynamics calculations.

The ternary Laves phase-based eutectic alloys CrFeNb x (x = 2.0, 2.35, 2.7, all compositions in this study were given in at.% unless otherwise stated) were prepared by vacuum non-consumable arc melting from high purity metals (> 99.95 wt.%). A little amount of titanium was melted before every ingot melting to eliminate the residual oxygen and nitrogen. Each ingot was inverted and re-melted for 5 times to ensure chemical homogeneity.
